description: Slide-to-confirm interaction. The inner .slide-handle is a role="slider" (aria-valuenow/-valuetext, aria-describedby hint); a tap, Enter, Space or End also confirms (WCAG 2.5.7 single-pointer alternative)

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Track label and handle accessible name. Default: the authored text content, else "Slide to confirm". Observed

attributes.name: activated-label
attributes.description: Label (and handle aria-valuetext) after activation, announced through a polite live region (default: "Confirmed!"). Observed

attributes.name: data-label-hint
attributes.description: Screen-reader hint wired with aria-describedby (default: "Press Enter to confirm"). Observed

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name; the value is submitted only once activated

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: valueMissing until activated, so the form cannot submit

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks drag, tap and keys (a disabled fieldset does the same); handle gets aria-disabled

attributes.name: data-dragging
attributes.description: Present while the handle is being dragged

attributes.name: transitioning
attributes.description: Internal: present during the spring-back transition

events.name: slide-accept:accept
events.description: Fired once on activation (drag past threshold, tap, Enter, Space or End)

events.name: slide-accept:reset
events.description: Fired after reset() (also on form reset when activated)

properties.name: activated
properties.description: Whether the component has been confirmed

methods.name: reset()
methods.description: Return the handle to the start, restore the label, clear the form value
